title: Neya
tagline: Neya is a fully decentralized 2-factor authenticator that helps you to stay safe on the web 3.0.
description: It is a fully decentralized 2-factor authenticator that uses a dynamic nft that generates a 16 digit code, so it's new every time. Then you use the neya site to decrypt the code and paste it in your main site. Here with the name of the NFT collection you'll gain full access to the site of our clients.
how_its_made: This project is made with react.js and also type script, for the design we use css and it is based on web 3.0 dynamic nft that creates the code we need to enter on the other sites.
